body:
## Pull request overview

This PR implements comprehensive Zod schemas for four new plugin system protocols, following the ObjectStack "Zod First" principle. The changes add runtime validation and JSON Schema generation capabilities for plugin validation, lifecycle events, startup orchestration, and service registry management.

**Changes:**
- Added Zod schemas for plugin validator, startup orchestrator, plugin lifecycle events, and service registry protocols
- Created comprehensive test suites covering 53 test cases across the four new schemas
- Generated JSON Schema files and documentation for all new data structures

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 38 out of 38 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| ---- | ----------- |

| packages/spec/src/system/plugin-validator.test.ts | Test coverage for plugin validator schemas |
| packages/spec/src/system/startup-orchestrator.zod.ts | Schemas for plugin startup configuration, health checks, and orchestration results |
| packages/spec/src/system/startup-orchestrator.test.ts | Test coverage for startup orchestrator schemas |
| packages/spec/src/system/plugin-lifecycle-events.zod.ts | Event schemas for plugin lifecycle phases, service/hook events, and kernel events |
| packages/spec/src/system/plugin-lifecycle-events.test.ts | Test coverage for lifecycle event schemas |
| packages/spec/src/system/service-registry.zod.ts | Schemas for service metadata, registry configuration, and scoped services |

| packages/spec/src/system/index.ts | Exports for the new schema modules |
| packages/spec/json-schema/system/*.json | Generated JSON Schema files for all new data structures |
| content/docs/references/system/meta.json | Documentation metadata updates |
| content/docs/references/system/index.mdx | Documentation index updates |
</details>
